name: BATTLE ART VOXEL FORK
description: 2.5D environments and native battle presentation for Gen 1, Crystal and FireRed/LeafGreen. Reviewed native-art scenery, furniture, gym/cave/interior profiles, lighting and water effects; shared settings inventory with functional native renderer, battle and interface adapters. Cross-generation feature parity remains incomplete; unsupported options stay visible with explicit limitations. See docs/NATIVE_PARITY_2026-09-22.md and docs/option-support.json.
